summary: A single white card (617x433, ~36px radius, 1px light-grey border, faint soft shadow beneath) sits slightly above centre on a flat #f9f9f9 page. Inside, a small grey label "Casting strength" heads a vertical radio group of three rows on a 111px pitch: Whisper / Chant / Invocation, each a 40px radio at x≈449 followed by a dark title and a grey one-line spell description at x≈515. The selected radio is a solid blue disc with a diagonal gradient (deeper #1f6de3 top-left to brighter #1b89e6 bottom-right) and a 12px white centre; unselected radios are 2px grey (#c9c9c9) rings. A hand cursor moves between rows; the hovered row gets a #f2f2f2 rounded (≈18px) pill 572x107 that fades in/out over ~0.2s, and hovered/selected titles darken to near-black. The signature move: on each click the selected blue disc disintegrates into square pixel particles (4–8px, mixed blues from #1f6de3 to pale sky blue) that stream along a curved arc — at times bulging outside the card's left edge — to the newly chosen radio, where they reassemble into the gradient disc; each transfer takes ≈0.5s. The selection hops Whisper→Chant (~1.0–1.5s), Chant→Invocation (~2.2–2.8s), Invocation→Whisper (~3.7–4.3s), Whisper→Chant (~4.9–5.3s), Chant→Invocation (~6.2–6.7s), Invocation→Whisper (~7.3–7.9s), Whisper→Invocation (~8.3–8.9s), Invocation→Whisper (~9.9–10.2s); the clip opens and closes with Whisper selected and an arrow cursor outside the card. The card, text and radios never move.

criteria.check: The page around the card is a flat light grey (~#f9f9f9) with no gradient or texture.
A single white card spans roughly x 405–1022 and y 323–756 (about 617x433 px), slightly above the vertical centre of the frame.
The card corners are generously rounded, radius about 36 px.
The card has a thin 1px light-grey (~#d9d9d9) border visible along its top edge.
A faint soft shadow fades out below the card over ~40–50 px; no hard dark drop edge.
The label reads exactly "Casting strength" at top-left of the card, x≈449, y≈365–387.
"Casting strength" is mid grey (~#666), clearly lighter than the option titles, and smaller (~22px).
Exactly three option rows are shown, each with a circular radio on the left and two lines of text.
Radio centres sit at x≈469 and y≈457, 568, 680 (a 111 px row pitch); titles start at x≈515.
Row 1 reads "Whisper" with "A quiet spell, barely felt" below it.
Row 2 reads "Chant" with "Steady power, held for a while" below it.
Row 3 reads "Invocation" with "Everything, all at once" below it.
Titles are ~26px regular/medium dark type; descriptions are ~22px and visibly lighter grey (~#666).
The selected option's title ("Whisper") is near-black, darker than the unselected "Invocation" title, which is dark grey.
The selected radio is a solid blue disc about 40 px wide with a small white circular centre about 12 px wide (a donut, not a ring with a dot inside).
The blue disc carries a diagonal gradient: deeper blue (~#1f6de3) toward the top-left, brighter sky blue (~#1b89e6) toward the bottom-right.
Unselected radios are 40 px circles with a thin ~2px light grey (~#c9c9c9) outline and a white interior, no fill.
The hovered row (Chant) has a light grey (~#f2f2f2) rounded pill behind it, about 572x107 px from x≈428 to 1000, corner radius ~18 px.
Only the row under the cursor has the grey highlight; the non-hovered rows sit on the plain white card.
A hand-pointer cursor is shown over the hovered row.
At the start the cursor is an arrow pointer outside the card to its right, and Whisper is selected.
On clicking Chant the blue Whisper disc breaks apart into small square pixels at its right side while still partly a disc.
The particles are crisp square pixels (about 4–8 px), not round dots, sparks or blurred smoke.
Particles are in mixed blues from the disc's deep blue to a pale sky blue, with no other hues.
The selection travels from Whisper to Chant: at 0.85s Whisper holds the blue disc; at 1.35s Whisper is an empty grey ring and the Chant disc is reassembling from pixels.
After the transfer only one radio is blue at a time; at 1.6s Chant is a complete donut and the other two are grey rings.
Particles travel along a curved arc, not a straight vertical line: at 2.5s the cloud bulges left past the card's left edge to about x≈365.
Particles outside the card are drawn over the page background; the card does not clip them.
Chant→Invocation: Chant selected at 1.9s; Invocation is a full blue donut by 2.8s.
Invocation→Whisper: at 3.75s the Invocation disc is shedding pixels upward with its top dissolving; at 4.25s Whisper is a complete blue donut and Invocation a grey ring.
Chant→Invocation again: at 6.3s the Chant disc is half-dissolved into pixels at its bottom; at 6.8s Invocation is the complete donut.
Invocation→Whisper at 7.4s: a diagonal stream of pixels rises from the Invocation radio up and right across the Chant row toward Whisper; by 7.9s Whisper is the solid donut and no particles remain.
Each transfer from the first pixel breaking off to the full disc reforming takes about 0.4–0.6 s.
The selection makes about 8 hops over the clip (W→C, C→I, I→W, W→C, C→I, I→W, W→I, I→W) and ends on Whisper.
The grey hover pill moves from Chant (0.85s) to Whisper (3.75s) as the cursor moves; it changes rows by fading, not sliding.
The hover fill fades over ~0.2s: at 7.9s the Chant pill is half-faded in and the Whisper pill half-faded out at the same moment.
A title darkens to near-black when its row is hovered or selected: "Whisper" is dark grey at 6.3s and near-black at 7.9s.
The card, label, radios and text do not move, scale or reflow between 0.85s and 7.9s; only the blue disc, particles, hover pill and cursor change.
The reformed disc is the same donut as before (40px blue gradient, 12px white centre) with no leftover pixels around it once settled.
At the end the cursor returns to an arrow outside the card's right edge and Whisper stays selected with no row highlighted.
